links.comparator_used: Initial (unsimplified) LLM responses to the same bariatric surgery FAQs, before the follow-up prompt to improve readability
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education responses (validated readability formulas)
links.effect: Initial LLM and institutional responses ranged from 9th grade to college graduate level; simplified LLM responses ranged from 6th grade to college freshman, a significant improvement. GPT-4 simplified responses were most readable (6th to 9th grade). Accuracy was similar between initial and simplified responses for all LLMs.
links.tradeoff: 34.8% of Bard's simplified responses were graded as less comprehensive than its initial responses. Comprehensiveness was similar for GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. Some simplified responses still exceeded the 6th grade target.
links.quote: Simplified responses from LLMs had significantly improved readability, with reading levels ranging from 6th grade to college freshman.

design_hint: reading-level simplification prompt for patient education
